Search for ACL 2021 and ACL 2022 best paper awards on the ACL Anthology website and add both entries to the table best_awards_acl.xlsx on the desktop. Record the title, year, author list (comma-separated), and official ACL Anthology PDF link. Ensure all PDF links are from aclanthology.org, not arXiv or other sources.

metadata.explanation: Variation 3: Task asks to find 2 ACL best paper awards (2021, 2022) and ensure PDF links are from aclanthology.org. Evaluator extracts paper data and verifies that: (1) at least 2 papers are present, (2) all URLs contain 'aclanthology.org', (3) the papers match the actual ACL 2021 and 2022 best paper awards by checking title keywords or specific URL patterns (e.g., '2021.acl-long.1'). This ensures only the actual best paper award winners are accepted, not any random ACL papers from those years.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the specific ACL 2021 and 2022 best paper awards through the expected_papers list with title_keywords and url_pattern matching
Title verification: Checks that at least 2 keywords from the expected list match the paper title (flexible fuzzy matching), allowing for title variations
URL verification: Checks that URLs contain specific paper ID patterns (2021.acl-long.1, 2022.acl-long.1) to identify the exact best paper awards
Domain verification: Verifies all URLs contain 'aclanthology.org' as required by instruction
Complete coverage: Checks all required fields (title, year, authors, URL) and verifies presence of both 2021 and 2022 best papers
Logical scoring: Appropriately weights finding correct papers (0.6) higher than URL domain (0.2) and authors (0.2), with partial credit for finding some expected papers
Flexible matching: Uses OR logic (title keywords OR URL pattern) for robustness, allowing verification even if title is abbreviated or URL structure varies slightly
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor refinement: The keyword matching requires 'at least 2 keywords' which works well with 4 keywords per paper, but consider adjusting threshold if keyword count changes to ensure robust matching
